title: वैकल्पिक शिक्षामा अनलाइन कक्षाको प्रभावकारीता {Effectiveness of Online Classes in Alternative Education}
nepali: वैकल्पिक शिक्षाले वर्तमान समयमा परम्परागत रूपमा चलिरहेको शिक्षा प्रर्णालीको विकल्पमा प्रदान गरिने शिक्षा पद्धतिलाई जनाउँछ । यस किसिमको शिक्षाले विभिन्न कारणले गर्दा शिक्षाको मूल धारमा आउन नसकेका व्यक्तिहरूलाई शैक्षिक अवसर तथा पहुँच प्रदान गर्ने कार्यमा माध्यमको रूपमा काम गर्दछ । कोभिड महामारीले निम्याएको स्वास्थ्य सङ्कटसँगै बैकल्पिक शिक्षाको आवश्यकता बढ्दै गएको परिवेशमा यस अध्ययनलाई विभिन्न किसिमका रोगहरूको चपेटामा समाज गुज्रँदा वैकल्पिक माध्यम के हुन सक्छ भन्ने सन्दर्भमा केन्द्रित गरिएको छ । अनलाइन कक्षाको सन्दर्भ तथा यसको प्रभावकारीता पहिचान गर्ने उद्धेश्य राखी तयार पारिएको यस लेखमा अनलाइन कक्षाले विश्वव्यापी महामारीको अवस्थामा मात्र नभई सामान्य अवस्थामा पनि कसरी वैकल्पिक शिक्षण सिकाइको माध्यमका रूपमा काम गर्न सक्छ भन्ने कुरालाई उजागर गरिएको छ । गुणात्मक विधिमा आधारित रहेर गोरखा नगरपालिकामा अवस्थित एक विद्यालयका शिक्षक र विद्यार्थीसँग अन्तक्र्रिया विधि मार्फत् तथ्यांकमा सङ्कलन गरि त्यसैका आधारमा यो लेख तयार गरिएको छ । प्राप्त सुचना र तथ्यांकको विश्लेषणबाट वर्तमान समयमा अनलाइन शिक्षा सामान्य शिक्षाको विकल्प मात्र नभइ समग्र शिक्षाको आवश्यक अंशका रूपमा कार्यान्वयनमा आएको पाइएको छ ।समय सापेक्ष आधुनिक शिक्षा पद्धतिको एउटा आवश्यकीय प्रक्रियाको रूपमा वैकल्पिक शिक्षालाई सरोकारवालाहरूले लिएको देखिन्छ । अध्ययनको प्राप्तिका आधारमा वैकल्पिक शिक्षालाई अनलाइन शिक्षा पद्धतिसँग जोडेर प्रविधिको प्रयोगसँगै प्रभावकारी शिक्षण सिकाइ क्रियाकलाप अगाडि बढाउनु आजको आवश्यकता रहेको छ ।
american_english: Alternative education refers to an educational method provided as an alternative to the traditional education system that has been operating conventionally in the present time. This type of education functions as a medium in the work of providing educational opportunities and access to individuals who could not enter the mainstream of education for various reasons. In the environment where the need for alternative education has been increasing along with the health crisis created by the COVID pandemic, this study has been centred on the context of what alternative mediums could be when society passes through the grip of various types of diseases. Prepared with the objective of identifying the context of online classes and their effectiveness, this article reveals how online classes can function as a medium of alternative teaching-learning not only in the situation of a global pandemic but also in normal circumstances. Based on the qualitative method, data was collected through the interaction method with teachers and students of one school located in Gorkha Municipality, and this article was prepared on that basis. Analysis of the obtained information and data shows that in the present time online education has come to be implemented as not only an alternative to traditional education but also as an essential part of holistic education. Concerned stakeholders have been seen taking alternative education as an essential process of time-relative modern educational methods. On the basis of the study's findings, it has become today's need to advance effective teaching-learning activities with the use of technology by linking alternative education with the online education method.

informal_english: Alternative education's basically an educational method offered as an alternative to the traditional system that's been running as usual. This kind of education acts as a way to give educational opportunities and access to folk who couldn't get into mainstream education for whatever reason. With the need for alternative education growing alongside the health crisis the COVID pandemic caused, this study looks at what alternative media could be when society's dealing with various diseases. The article was put together to figure out the context of online classes and how effective they are, and it shows how online classes can work as a medium for alternative teaching and learning not just during a global pandemic but in normal times too. Using a qualitative approach, data was gathered by interacting with teachers and students at a school in Gorkha Municipality, and the article's based on that. The analysis shows that right now online education has been implemented as not just an alternative to traditional education but as an essential part of holistic education. The stakeholders have been seen taking alternative education on board as an essential process of modern educational methods that fit the times. Based on the findings, the need today is to push forward effective teaching-learning activities using technology by linking alternative education with online education.

'महानगरपालिका' transliterated as 'Municipality'. 'कोभिड' = COVID. 'बैकल्पिक' = alternative. 'प्रविधि' = technology.
